name: Toolbar
layerWhy: It groups controls for one thing; each control is its own action.
promise: The controls for this thing, one tab stop.
expectation: A row of controls under a line, groups divided.
evidence: Tab reaches it once; arrows move between controls, following the reading direction; the last used is remembered.
behaviour: Home and End go to the ends.
accessibility: role="toolbar" with a label; a roving tab stop.
failures: Never more than one tab stop.

usage.markup:
<primal-toolbar label="Text formatting">
  <button primalIconButton type="button" label="Bold">…</button>
  <hr class="pr-divider" />
  <button primalButton type="button" emphasis="quiet">Insert Link</button>
</primal-toolbar>
